title: Decoration
description: Rounding, blur, shadows, glow and opacity

options.label: Corner radius
options.description: How round window corners are

options.label: Corner shape
options.description: Curvature of the corners. 2 is a circle, higher values give a squarer look

options.label: Active window opacity
options.description: Opacity of the focused window

options.label: Inactive window opacity
options.description: Opacity of windows that are not focused

options.label: Fullscreen opacity
options.description: Opacity of fullscreen windows

options.label: Blur
options.description: Blur the background behind transparent windows

options.label: Blur radius
options.description: Distance of the blur effect. Larger values are blurrier but slower

options.label: Blur passes
options.description: Number of blur iterations. More passes look smoother but cost performance

options.label: Noise
options.description: Amount of grain added to the blurred area

options.label: Contrast
options.description: Contrast of the blurred area

options.label: Brightness
options.description: Brightness of the blurred area

options.label: Vibrancy
options.description: Color saturation boost of the blurred area

options.label: Vibrancy darkness
options.description: How strongly vibrancy applies to dark colors

options.label: X-ray blur
options.description: Blur only the wallpaper, not windows behind the current one. Faster and uniform

options.label: Blur under translucent areas
options.description: Make blur work with windows that use partial opacity

options.label: Optimized blur
options.description: Use faster blur shortcuts

options.label: Blur special workspace
options.description: Blur behind the special workspace

options.label: Blur popups
options.description: Blur behind popups and context menus

options.label: Popup blur threshold
options.description: Pixels below this opacity are not blurred in popups

options.label: Blur input methods
options.description: Blur behind input method windows

options.label: Input method blur threshold
options.description: Pixels below this opacity are not blurred in input method windows

options.label: Shadow
options.description: Draw drop shadows behind windows

options.label: Shadow size
options.description: How far the shadow reaches from the window

options.label: Shadow color
options.description: Color of the shadow of the focused window

options.label: Inactive shadow color
options.description: Color of the shadow of unfocused windows. White means use the normal shadow color

options.label: Shadow offset
options.description: Horizontal and vertical shift of the shadow as two numbers, for example 0 5

options.label: Shadow falloff
options.description: How quickly the shadow fades out. Higher values fade faster

options.label: Shadow scale
options.description: Size of the shadow relative to the window

options.label: Sharp shadow
options.description: Use a hard-edged shadow instead of a smooth one

options.label: Glow
options.description: Draw a glow around windows

options.label: Glow size
options.description: How far the glow reaches from the window

options.label: Glow color
options.description: Color of the glow of the focused window

options.label: Inactive glow color
options.description: Color of the glow of unfocused windows

options.label: Glow falloff
options.description: How quickly the glow fades out. Higher values fade faster

groups.title: Dimming
groups.description: Darken windows that are not the focus

options.label: Dim inactive windows
options.description: Darken windows that are not focused

options.label: Dim strength
options.description: How dark inactive windows become

options.label: Dim behind special workspace
options.description: How much the screen is darkened behind the special workspace

options.label: Dim around floating windows
options.description: Darkening applied by the dim around window rule

options.label: Dim behind dialogs
options.description: Darken the parent window while a modal dialog is open

options.label: Motion blur
options.description: Blur fast-moving content to smooth animations

options.label: Motion blur samples
options.description: Number of samples used for motion blur. More is smoother but heavier

options.label: Screen shader
options.description: Path to a GLSL fragment shader applied to the whole screen. Leave empty for none
